cases.topic: 初等数论：整数整除与线性组合
cases.source: 设 a,b,d∈ℤ，且 d∣a、d∣b。证明 d∣(2a−3b)。原证明：由 d∣a，存在 u∈ℤ，使 a=du；由 d∣b，存在 v∈ℤ，使 b=dv。于是 2a−3b=2du−3dv=d(2u−3v)。由于 2u−3v∈ℤ，根据整除的定义，d∣(2a−3b)。证毕。

originalProofFidelity.basis: Formal Kernel proof alone cannot certify an author's natural-language reasoning. Unrecognized source rule remains unconfirmed.

reasoningFidelity.explanation: Only exact source-anchored equations with an independently checked arithmetic inference rule and a genuine Kernel certificate are certified. Model proof reconstruction alone never qualifies. Unrecognized natural language is unconfirmed, not disproved.

cases.topic: 实代数：二维柯西-施瓦茨不等式
cases.source: 设 a,b,c,d∈ℝ。证明 (ac+bd)²≤(a²+b²)(c²+d²)。原证明：展开并整理可得 (a²+b²)(c²+d²)−(ac+bd)²=a²d²+b²c²−2abcd=(ad−bc)²。由于任意实数的平方均非负，故 (ad−bc)²≥0。因此 (a²+b²)(c²+d²)−(ac+bd)²≥0，即 (ac+bd)²≤(a²+b²)(c²+d²)。证毕。
